en.approval.whyRepeating: TALOS asks because nothing changed between these calls. With “Deny” the run stops here.

en.approval.whyCoordinationOff: It asks because “Coordination” is off in this session: with it on, the model starts agents on its own.
en.approval.whyCoordinationCapOne: It asks because {n} agent has already started on its own in this conversation: that is the most allowed.
en.approval.whyCoordinationCapMany: It asks because {n} agents have already started on their own in this conversation: that is the most allowed.

en.approval.whyToolGate: It asks because the rule for “{attrezzo}” is “Ask for confirmation”, even with the session on “{politica}”.
en.approval.whyOnRequest: It asks because the session is on “{politica}”: every action that changes something goes through you.
en.approval.whyKernel: It asks because the kernel treats this action as one to confirm, even with the session on “{politica}”.
